errors.text_span: 右侧纵轴表示“新闻媒体每日报道数目”
errors.evidence: This incorrectly interprets the right y-axis, which represents the number of news reports related to COVID-19, not just general news.
The values stated are inaccurate; the actual values as per the figure are different.
The description does not mention the color scheme used in the bars and line graph, nor the visual features that might differentiate them.
The description fails to clearly state the chart's purpose as comparing the number of new COVID-19 cases to media coverage.
